Questions about activity at work (current main job) asked in the pre-assessment booklet in 2006-10 data collection. Variables were also used to derive some of the EPAQ2 derived variables
linked_rows: Standing - moderate work e.g. fast rate assembly line work or lifting up to 50 lbs every 5 minutes for a few seconds at a time: how many hours per week have you done this? - at age 60-64 years
cat_rows: EPIC Physical activity questionnaire - raw variables [52112]

This category contains raw data from the EPAQ2, which assessed self-report physical activity in four domains (leisure time, occupation, transportation and domestic life). Estimates of PA energy expenditure (PAEE) sedentary behaviour, light (LPA) and moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA) were obtained from EPAQ2.
